item.title: Chicken Bhuna
item.description:
Ingredients

Serves 3

  • 3 chicken fillets, cut into bite-sized pieces
  • 5 tbsp oil
  • 1 tsp cumin seeds
  • ½ tsp hing (asafoetida)
  • 1 dried red chilli
  • 1 onion, finely chopped
  • 1 inch fresh ginger, grated
  • 3 garlic cloves, grated
  • 1 fresh green chilli, finely chopped
  • 400g tin chopped tomatoes
  • 3 tbsp natural yoghurt, whisked
  • Fresh coriander, to garnish

Spice paste

  • ⅓ tsp turmeric
  • 1 tsp cumin powder
  • 1 tsp coriander powder
  • ½ tsp chilli powder
  • ¾ tsp salt
  • 1 tsp garam masala
  • 2 tbsp oil, to loosen

Method

  1. Prep everything first. Mix the turmeric, cumin powder, coriander powder, chilli powder, salt, and garam masala with oil until the consistency of yoghurt. Have all other ingredients ready before you start cooking.

item.title: Rigatoni with Brown Mushrooms and Pesto
item.description:
Ingredients

Serves 2

  • 250g rigatoni
  • 250g brown mushrooms
  • 150g baby spinach
  • ½ red onion, finely diced (brunoise)
  • 200ml double cream
  • 3 tbsp pesto
  • 30g Parmesan, grated
  • 50ml olive oil
  • Salt, pepper, and chilli flakes

Method

  1. Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil.

  2. Sauté the onion in olive oil over medium heat until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook until lightly browned.

  3. Cook the rigatoni for 8 minutes until al dente. Reserve a cup of pasta water before draining.
